title: Gold 4H context with 5M breakout trigger
description: A governed package composing a 4H golden-cross context with a 5M range-breakout trigger.
thesis: Breakouts taken in the direction of an established higher-timeframe trend regime resolve more often than breakouts taken against it.
intended_style: Trend-aligned intraday breakout, one setup per context episode.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: Fast simple moving average of close.
Slow simple moving average of close.
High of the preceding consolidation range.
Low of the preceding consolidation range.

atomic_strategies.title: Golden cross
atomic_strategies.description: Fast moving average crosses above the slow moving average on the evaluated timeframe.
atomic_strategies.thesis: A sustained shift of the short-horizon mean above the long-horizon mean marks a regime in which continuation is more likely than mean reversion.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: Fast simple moving average of close.
Slow simple moving average of close.

parameters.name: fast_period
parameters.description: Lookback of the fast moving average, in bars of the evaluated timeframe.

parameters.name: slow_period
parameters.description: Lookback of the slow moving average, in bars of the evaluated timeframe.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: LONG when fast crosses above slow; SHORT when fast crosses below slow.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True on the bar the cross completes.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the bar did or did not match.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Fast crosses from below to above slow on the evaluated bar.
Fast stays below slow across both bars.

provenance.source_reference: HSA v1 contract fixture — canonical atomic example named at PID line 55.

atomic_strategies.title: Range breakout
atomic_strategies.description: Close breaks beyond the high or low of the preceding consolidation range by a bounded margin.
atomic_strategies.thesis: A decisive close outside a compressed range signals that accumulated order flow has resolved in one direction.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: High of the preceding consolidation range.
Low of the preceding consolidation range.

parameters.name: range_lookback
parameters.description: Number of bars used to define the consolidation range.

parameters.name: break_margin_ratio
parameters.description: Minimum break beyond the range boundary, as a fraction of the range height. Replaces the discretionary phrase good breakout with a measurable threshold.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: LONG on a break above range.high; SHORT on a break below range.low.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True when the close breaks the range by at least the margin.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the bar did or did not match.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Close exceeds range.high by more than the margin.
Close exceeds range.high by less than the margin.

provenance.source_reference: HSA v1 contract fixture — canonical atomic example named at PID line 55.

chain.title: Higher-timeframe context with lower-timeframe breakout trigger
chain.description: A 4H golden cross must hold as context while a 5M range breakout fires as trigger.

state_semantics.state_transition_rule: IDLE to CONTEXT_ACTIVE when the context input matches; CONTEXT_ACTIVE to MATCHED when the trigger input matches in the same direction; MATCHED to IDLE on reset.
reset_conditions: Context input ceases to match on its own timeframe.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: Direction is taken from the context input; the trigger must agree or the chain does not match.

persistence.re_arm_rule: Re-arms once the state returns to CONTEXT_ACTIVE after a reset.

expiry.expiry_rule: An unconsumed match expires 12 bars of the 5M timeframe after it is produced.

provenance.source_reference: HSA v1 contract fixture — shape of PID acceptance example A (PID lines 234-236).

direction_semantics.direction_rule: Direction is taken from the context input; the trigger must agree or the chain does not match.

persistence.re_arm_rule: Re-arms once the state returns to CONTEXT_ACTIVE after a reset.

expiry.expiry_rule: An unconsumed match expires 12 bars of the 5M timeframe after it is produced.

state_semantics.state_transition_rule: IDLE to CONTEXT_ACTIVE when the context input matches; CONTEXT_ACTIVE to MATCHED when the trigger input matches in the same direction; MATCHED to IDLE on reset.
reset_conditions: Context input ceases to match on its own timeframe.

invalidation_conditions: The 4H golden-cross context ceases to hold before the trigger fires.
The 5M trigger fires in the opposite direction to the context.
validity_conditions: Evaluated on 5M bar close during hours when 4H moving averages have sufficient history.

parameters.name: max_setups_per_context
parameters.description: Maximum number of chain matches emitted per context episode, before the context must reset.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True when context and trigger both hold in the same direction.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: LONG or SHORT, inherited from the context input.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Explicit reason for the match or non-match.

fields.name: per_input_reasons
fields.description: Per-input attribution built from each atomic strategy's own reason field.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Context holds LONG on 4H and the 5M breakout fires LONG within the persistence window.
The 5M breakout fires but the 4H context is not active.

backtest_requirements: At least 24 months of XAUUSD 5M and 4H history covering trending and ranging regimes.
Out-of-sample segment held back and evaluated once.
forward_test_requirements: Forward evaluation over a period not used in any parameter selection.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The backtest must produce at least the minimum number of qualifying setups.

rejection_criteria.statement: Reject if out-of-sample expectancy is negative.
Reject if expectancy is only positive at a single parameter setting.
